published_prior_art.cite: TehSadeghiSoo2025RobustID gives a sufficient simultaneous-identification criterion across candidate SA-MPDAGs; the proposed iff is the general gluing principle for a union of law images.

repo_prior_art.cite: scm_cs_hedge_completeness — conditional SS-ID completeness frontier concerns selector-context witnesses, not exact-refinement common-law collisions.

published_prior_art.cite: ShpitserPearl2006JointID supplies fixed-ADMG hedge witnesses; ZhangTianBareinboim2022PartialCF supplies fixed-graph finite canonicalization, while the proposed cross-refinement positivity-preserving compression is narrower but distinct.

FerreiraAssaad2025CDMGADMG treats C-DMG-over-ADMG identification under its cluster-size regime, and YvernesEtAl2026DerivationGraphs normalizes do-calculus derivations in one ADMG; neither verified source gives a terminating exact-known-size refinement-image overlap compiler.

AnandRibeiroTianBareinboim2023CDAG proves ID completeness for acyclic C-DAGs; FerreiraAssaad2025CDMGADMG covers a different C-DMG size regime. The proposed known-size singleton-cycle extension is not verified as subsumed.

FerreiraAssaad2025CDMGADMG arXiv v2 explicitly conditions its nonidentification results on Assumption 1, including the restriction on adjacent singleton clusters in cycles; the claimed excluded known-size regime is plausibly distinct but lacks an exhibited instance.

BhattacharyaNabiShpitser2022Semiparametric gives fixed-graph graphical-functional inference; applying a multinomial delta method to a certified smooth circuit branch is a useful implementation layer but not an independent identification advance.

FangSantos2019DirectionalInference supplies the adjacent nonregular-inference framework; rectangle propagation through finitely many certified branches is a natural finite-sample corollary once the circuit exists.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 4 (strict extension)
novelty_flags.one_line: The asserted strict known-size cyclic separation is only existential: no labelled cyclic quotient, two refinements, common positive law, or construction route is committed, so the flagship extension cannot yet be independently checked and is capped at field.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1 (semantic union)
soundness_flags.one_line: The iff is a direct gluing/unfolding of global uniform identification over a union of refinement-specific model classes; retain it as a preliminary lemma or add a substantive consequence rather than presenting it as a standalone theorem-level contribution.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1 / Theorem 3 / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Termination, overlap coverage, disagreement-preserving witness extraction, and the E4 size analysis are not proved; Theorem 3 is conditional on a saturation satisfying the specified handle.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Global-CID completeness and the E4 bound are claimed only conditional on a constructed ranked fixing-overlap saturation; the OEQ remains the constructive headline target.
